sources.section: RMDs start with the year the owner reaches 73 (tax years 2023 and later), on the prior 31 December balance
sources.note: Web page, last reviewed 2026-01-29. Primary for start age 73 (and 72 for owners born 1950 or earlier, who reached 72 before 2023).
